text.tspan: The exact sequence required to safely discover, launch, prompt, read, and coordinate a secondary agent without user disruption.
Inspect registered shells and availability before creating or starting.
Enumerate existing shells, agent bindings, and idle status.
Allocate the terminal split in the layout before launching the provider.
Creates dedicated managed shell tab with a workspace row
Launch the configured provider and block until its session hook reports ready.
Injected hook notifies Sidecar that provider prompt loop
Dispatch task text and observe lifecycle progress.
Agent executes tools and completes review.
Never blind-type: read unwrapped terminal output to verify agent state before answering.
